soundness_flags.label: def:quadratic-drift and all results using Q, B2, or B2hat
soundness_flags.one_line: The core invokes \(\epsilon^{it}\) inside \(q_{it}(P_{\Omega^{it}}\epsilon^{it})\) without defining its local restriction/reindexing, so the quadratic map and its conditional expectation are not unambiguously typed.

soundness_flags.label: def:frontier-class, def:rankone-calibration-array, and oeq:sharp-phase-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: The frontier class imports \(\sigma_r(M^{it})\ge\psi\), but the stated rank-one calibration has \(\psi_{\mathrm{loc},it}/\psi\to\sqrt{3/8}<1\); hence the advertised rank-one exterior route cannot satisfy the class's remaining primitive conditions as written.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 2 and Open-ended Question 1
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The claims are conditional on known fixed exact rank and dependence range, deterministic common-start masking, rowwise conditional independence, common stationary finite-range covariance, restricted-Gram geometry, and the stated signal regime.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Uniform coverage is claimed only over the repaired deterministic-MNAR weak-signal class; any sharp frontier is only for the separately defined exponent-indexed version of that class.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published article exists and describes deterministic/MNAR matrix completion by dividing missing entries into groups, nuclear-norm estimation, debiasing, and asymptotic normality under fairly weak signals.
The article exists and studies no-sample-splitting inference after nuclear-norm penalization, allowing dependent observation patterns and heterogeneous observation probabilities.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2402.05789v1, corroborating the cited Journal of Econometrics article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work concerns PC estimation with weak factors and suitable noise dependence, using an eigendecomposition and leave-one-out proof strategy.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define \(\epsilon^{it}\) explicitly as a restriction/reindexing to the local block and state the corresponding projection operator; then rewrite every quadratic-drift and fitted-Hessian formula against that common local coordinate system.

Reconcile the local signal scale by either replacing \(\sigma_r(M^{it})\ge\psi\) with \(\sigma_r(M^{it})\ge c_{\mathrm{loc}}\psi\) for a declared constant or redefining \(\psi\) locally, then recheck the signal envelope and every frontier exponent calculation.

For the frontier, state the exterior rank-one family with the repaired local-signal constant and identify which named remainder fails on each boundary face; this turns the current handle into a directly falsifiable sharpness program.

recommended_next_step: Repair the local-coordinate and local-signal-class inconsistencies, then rerun the proposal review before advancing to Stage 0.
